res=[]

    s = sub.set_index('date')['unblended_cost']
    if anom not in s.index: continue
    expected = np.mean([s.get(anom-pd.Timedelta(weeks=w), np.nan) for w in (1,2,3)])
    if np.isnan(expected) or expected==0: continue
    val = s[anom]
    # scale of typical variation across those same weekdays
    hist = [s.get(anom-pd.Timedelta(weeks=w)) for w in range(1,7)]
    hist = [h for h in hist if not np.isnan(h)]
    sd = np.std(hist) if len(hist)>2 else 1
    res.append((*k, val, expected, (val-expected)/sd, val-expected))
r = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=[*key,'val','exp','z','delta']).sort_values('z',ascending=False)
print(r.head(8).to_string())

    ni = s['num_instances']

    rows.append((*k, ni[anom], med, z, s.loc[anom,'unblended_cost']-prior.mean()))
